text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off. While out in town shopping, I 
ran into some Umamusume I recognized.
choice_data_list: Are you two out shopping together?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tap's Trainer! Nah, we just ran into 
each other a second ago.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Good timing! You come along too, it's way 
more fun with more company!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're here! There was some sweets 
I really wanted, so I've been dying to 
come here!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what a coincidence! I come here often 
too. Maybe I'll buy my usual while I'm at 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tap & Ace
text_block_list.text:
Gimme this Carrot Yokan! Give me this 
Carrot Yokan, please!

text_block_list.name: Tap & Ace
text_block_list.text: "...What? ...Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I can't believe Ace likes it too! 
The harmony between the sweet bean paste 
and carrot is exquisite, isn't it?!
choice_data_list: I guess things like this happen too, huh.
I guess things like this happen too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At this point, I still thought it was 
just a coincidence, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Totally! This shampoo really is great, 
isn't it? Keeps your hair from getting all 
dry~.
choice_data_list: Is the shampoo the same one too...?
Is it the same for shampoo...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
That sportswear is the exact same as mine! 
It's super easy to move in and really 
durable!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, we even went to the same 
sporting goods store.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even Ace is a regular here?! We really 
must hit it off well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could two things really match up this 
perfectly? ...Come to think of it.
choice_data_list: Tap really admires Ace, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Less respect and more like... she's just 
an amazing Umamusume! You don't see 
someone with such a badass running style 
just anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then it makes me wonder. The reason Tap 
Dance City shares so much of the same 
taste as Katsuragi Ace is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to be an Umamusume like Ace. Could 
that admiration have taken shape without 
even realizing it herself...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Heeey! Tap, got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I just can't settle on the right 
horseshoes, y'know~ So, I've got a favor 
to ask you, Tap—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Which one would I pick, since we have 
similar tastes? Well, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOH!! It feels so natural!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're crazy good at picking horseshoes! 
Trainer, did you teach her that?
choice_data_list:
No, it's just that Tap watches your 
running very closely.

No, it's just that Tap watches your 
running very closely.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Me?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously! Your front-running is 
always out of this world.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Anyone would end up watching. Wondering 
what it takes to run like that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Tap really is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? What do you mean, 'amazing'...?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You watched my running closely enough to 
know the exact right horseshoes for me, 
right? Not just anyone could do that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
As a front runner myself— I can't let 
myself lose to Tap!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I can't back down... Is the ace role 
falling to... me...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha...! Right, is that how it is!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, hahaha! After all, I'm an 
Umamusume who's gonna make a massive dream 
come true someday!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Fufu... ...Hehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being acknowledged by the one she admires, 
she's walking on air. Yet it seems she 
hasn't even noticed those feelings 
herself.
choice_data_list:
Want to try running with Ace while you're 
at it?
That's kind of heartwarming, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being acknowledged by the one she admires, 
she's walking on air. Yet it seems she 
hasn't even noticed those feelings 
herself.
choice_data_list:
Want to try running with Ace while you're 
at it?
That's kind of heartwarming, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I love that idea! I'm so excited, I 
can't sit still!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! I was just thinking how much 
I wanted to run with you in these 
horseshoes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, Tap Dance City ran alongside 
Katsuragi Ace, a smile still on her face."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heartwarming...? Are you sure you're using 
that word right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You bet! We've got way more of that, like, 
roaring fire burning inside us!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! How should I put it... It's 
like my whole body's itching to go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And for quite a while after that, Tap 
Dance City stayed in high spirits the 
entire time.”
